## Load data

```{r}
species_names_checks <- read.csv("../data/species_names_checks.csv")
```


```{r}
## Importing tree
tree <- read.tree(here::here("clads/cleannames_tree_041024.txt"))

## Rescaling branch lengths by a scale of 10 to reflect time
tree$edge.length <- tree$edge.length * 10

## Making sure the tree is still ultrametric
is.ultrametric(tree)

## Replacing "." in species names for CLaDS not to complain
tree$tip.label <- gsub(".", "-", tree$tip.label, fixed = TRUE)

## Writing tree to file
#write.tree(tree, here::here("clads/naesiotus_rescaled.tre"))
#write.tree(tree, here::here("bamm/naesiotus_rescaled.tre"))

load(here::here("clads/naesiotus_clads_rates.RData"))

bamm.data <- getEventData(tree, here::here("bamm/event_data.txt"), burnin = 0.1)
```



```{r}
# Step 1: Ensure Tip Labels Are Correct
# Correct species names in CladsOutput$tree using your species_names_checks.csv if necessary.
#species_name_corrections <- read.csv("species_names_checks.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

correct_species_names <- function(original_names, corrections_df) {
  # Create a named vector for lookup
  correction_map <- setNames(corrections_df$species_name, corrections_df$annotated_name)
  
  # Correct the names
  corrected_names <- sapply(original_names, function(name) {
    if (name %in% names(correction_map)) {
      correction_map[name]  # Replace if in annotated_name
    } else {
      name  # Keep original if not found
    }
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  
  return(corrected_names)
}

# Apply the function to CladsOutput tip labels
CladsOutput$tree$tip.label <- correct_species_names(CladsOutput$tree$tip.label, species_names_checks)





# Step 2: Define Indices
br.ind <- 4:(4 + CladsOutput$tree$Nnode - 1)  # Branch indices
tip.ind <- (max(br.ind) + 1):(max(br.ind) + Ntip(CladsOutput$tree))  # Tip indices

# Step 3: Extract Posterior Distributions for Tips
post.dist.tips <- lapply(tip.ind, function(idx) {
  sapply(CladsOutput$chains, `[[`, idx)  # Extract the posterior for each tip
})

# Step 4: Discard Burn-in
post.dist.tips <- lapply(post.dist.tips, function(chain) {
  chain[251:1000, ]  # Discard the first 250 iterations as burn-in
})

# Step 5: Match Tip Names to Rates
tip_names <- CladsOutput$tree$tip.label
posterior_samples <- do.call(cbind, post.dist.tips)
colnames(posterior_samples) <- tip_names

# Step 6: Sample Rates for Each Tip and Create a DataFrame
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
sampled.rates <- as.data.frame(t(apply(posterior_samples, 2, function(rate) {
  sample(rate, 50, replace = TRUE)  # Sample 50 rates for each tip
})))
colnames(sampled.rates) <- paste0("species_speciation_rate_", 1:50)
sampled.rates$Species <- rownames(sampled.rates)

# Step 7: Reshape Data for Plotting
library(tidyr)
sampled.rates_long <- pivot_longer(
  sampled.rates,
  cols = starts_with("species_speciation_rate_"),
  names_to = "Sample",
  values_to = "Rate"
)

# Step 8: Plot Posterior Distributions
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(sampled.rates_long, aes(x = Rate)) +
  geom_density(fill = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +  # Facet by species
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Distributions of Tip-Specific Speciation Rates",
    x = "Speciation Rate",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Adjust species label size
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")     # Spacing between panels
  )

```
